name: Metro Holdings Limited
summary: Metro Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in retail, and property development and investment businesses in Singapore, China, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, Australia, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Property Investment and Development, and Retail. It leases shopping and office spaces, as well as invests in property-related investments; and develops and sells residential and mixed-use properties. The company offers a range of merchandise products, men's and women's fashion products, kids wear, toys, and home and bedding products through a chain of 2 Metro department stores in Singapore. Metro Holdings Limited was founded in 1957 and is based in Singapore.
